title_zh: 为什么成就触发错记成 S1, 不是 S3
title_en: Why I file advancement misfires as S1, not S3
summary_zh: 一条成就在错的时机解锁, 看起来只是个小毛病。但它在撒谎: 系统告诉玩家 "你做了 X", 而玩家什么都没做。这是诚信问题, 不是polish。
summary_en: An advancement firing at the wrong moment looks like a small cosmetic bug. It isn't — it lies to the player. The system says "you did X" when the player didn't. That's an integrity bug, not polish.

title_zh: 兼容矩阵: Hot Bath 上跑出 6 个独立场景的实战
title_en: The compat matrix: 6 independent scenarios from one Hot Bath round
summary_zh: 草稿中。先记一笔: 我现在测每个温度类 mod, 默认要把 Cold Sweat / Serene Seasons / ToughAsNails / LSO 全部装上, 因为它们之中一定有人和你打架。
summary_en: Draft. Note to self: every temperature-class mod I test now ships with Cold Sweat / Serene Seasons / ToughAsNails / LSO bundled, because one of them is always going to fight you.

title_zh: 回归轮次的经济学: 4 轮够 Hot Bath, 5 轮才够 Shower Core
title_en: The economy of regression rounds: 4 was enough for Hot Bath, 5 for Shower Core
summary_zh: 草稿中。决定测几轮不是看 mod 大小, 是看作者修 bug 时引入新 bug 的密度。Shower Core 的引入率高, 所以 4.5 / 4.6 / 4.18 三轮里每轮都有新东西。
summary_en: Draft. The number of rounds isn't a function of mod size — it's the rate at which the author introduces new bugs while fixing old ones. Shower Core's introduction rate was high, so 4.5 / 4.6 / 4.18 each surfaced new things.
